os: This system is not supported: it takes macOS, Linux or Windows on an x64 or arm64 processor.
tools: curl and tar are needed: install them and run the command again.
tty: Run the command in a terminal window: it asks questions.
download: A download failed. Check your connection and run the command again.
checksum: The downloaded Node.js did not match its checksum. Run the command again.
core: Downloading the AI The Route helper…
gone: This token no longer works. Open "My tokens" in the bot: extend it, or take the command from a new message.
invalid: This command does not fit. Copy it whole from the bot's message.
notClaude: This command sets up Claude Code, and this token is for another provider. Follow the bot's setup file for it.
claudeFailed: Claude Code could not be installed. The details are above.
env: Saving the AI The Route settings…
pairFailed: The login helper could not connect. Run the command again; if it keeps failing, write to us: "Help" → "Write to support".
signIn: The helper's page opens now; it is in Russian. When it shows "Маршрут готов" (the route is ready), press "Начать вход" (start sign-in) and sign in to your Claude account. It needs a Pro, Max, Ultra, Team or Enterprise plan.
paste: Copy the sign-in token from the window above (a long line starting with sk-ant-oat01-), paste it here and press Enter twice:
noToken: No sign-in token was received. Run the command again.
checkFailed: The settings are saved, but the test request failed. Open a new terminal and run claude; an answer starting with "AI The Route:" says why.
done: Done! Open a new terminal (restart VS Code or Cursor completely), go to your project's folder and type claude.
command: Paste the command or link from the bot's message and press Enter:
envFailed: The settings could not be saved. The details are above.
apiKey: Note: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set. Claude Code uses it instead of your subscription sign-in, and requests are billed to that key. Remove it from your terminal settings to work on your subscription.
commandOrKeep: Paste the command or link from the bot's new message and press Enter. To keep the current token, just press Enter:
unreachable: Could not reach the AI The Route gateway. Check your internet connection and run the command again.
tooMany: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a few minutes and run the command again.
incomplete: Some of the installer's files are missing. Download the archive or copy the command from the bot again.
foreignEnv: Your terminal settings set {names}: Claude Code would use them instead of AI The Route. Remove them from your shell settings (or the environment variables on Windows) and run the command again.
foreignSettings: The env section of {file} sets {names}: they override the AI The Route settings. Remove them from there (or rename the file) and run the command again.
noNpm: npm was not found beside Node.js. Install npm (for example sudo apt install npm) or take the old Node.js off PATH, and run the command again.
keptSignIn: Your Claude sign-in is already set up and works: keeping it.
noBrowser: The helper needs Google Chrome, Chromium or Microsoft Edge for the sign-in, and none is installed. Install one and run the command again. Or sign in on another computer and paste the sign-in token here.
linuxSignIn: On Linux the helper opens the sign-in in a separate sandbox. It needs bubblewrap, Xephyr, Chromium and Node.js 24.5+ in /usr/bin, Claude Code from Anthropic's package repository (apt, dnf or apk: it puts claude in /usr/bin; npm with sudo will not do) and an X11 desktop. Easier: run this same command on your Mac or Windows computer and paste the sign-in token here.
pasteOther: Paste the sign-in token (it starts with sk-ant-oat01-) and press Enter twice. On a Mac set up with this command it is in ~/.aitheroute/env.sh (the CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN line); on Windows, echo %CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN% in a cmd window shows it:
rcFailed: The settings are saved, but {file} could not be changed. Add this line to it: {line}
nodeFailed: Node.js 24.5 or newer could not be started. Update your system or install Node.js from nodejs.org, and run the command again.
flagsFailed: {file} could not be changed: it does not read as JSON. Fix or rename it and run the command again.
guardAsk: Turn on the leak guard? Claude Code on this computer will go through AI The Route even where a terminal or an editor has not loaded the settings. You can turn it off at any time. Turn it on? [y/N]
guardHostsAsk: Also close Anthropic's direct addresses (claude.ai, api.anthropic.com and others) to every program on this computer, the Claude Desktop app and claude.ai in your usual browser included? The sign-in through the helper keeps working. This needs administrator rights. Close them? [y/N]
guardOn: The leak guard is on: Claude Code goes through AI The Route, Anthropic's direct addresses are closed. To turn it off: {off}
guardSettingsOnly: Claude Code's guard is on: its sessions go through AI The Route unless a project's or a launch's settings say otherwise. Anthropic's direct addresses stay open to other programs. To turn it off: {off}
guardHostsLeft: Claude Code's settings are back, but the AI The Route block is still in {file}: the file could not be changed (it needs administrator rights, or the file is write-protected). Turn the guard off again or delete the block from the file by hand.
guardIsOn: The leak guard is on: Claude Code goes through AI The Route, Anthropic's direct addresses are closed. To turn it off: {cmd} off
guardIsSettingsOnly: Claude Code's guard is on, Anthropic's direct addresses are open. To close them: {cmd} on. To turn it off: {cmd} off
guardIsHostsOnly: Claude Code's guard is off, but Anthropic's direct addresses are still closed in {file}. To open them: {cmd} off
guardIsOff: The leak guard is off. To turn it on: {cmd} on
guardNoSetup: Set up AI The Route first: run start and paste the command from the bot.
guardUsage: The leak guard: {cmd} on to turn it on, {cmd} off to turn it off, {cmd} status to check.
guardHostsRights: Claude Code's guard is on, but Anthropic's direct addresses stay open: {file} could not be changed (it needs administrator rights, or the file is write-protected). To turn it off: {off}
guardHostsEncoding: Claude Code's guard is on, but Anthropic's direct addresses stay open: {file} is in UTF-16, and the guard changes plain text files only. To turn it off: {off}
guardHostsShadowed: But {file} has lines of its own for {hosts} above the guard: the system takes those, so these addresses are not closed. Delete those lines or put # before them.
